releases.notes:
## Vanilla+ RPG & Shop v1.0.0

### Features
- 🎮 6 Skills with progression (Farming, Combat, Defense, Smithing, Woodcutting, Mining)
- 🔥 **NEW**: Smelting rewards for Smithing skill!
- 💰 Economy system with 100+ items organized in categories
- 🛒 Shop with logical item sorting (pickaxes together, axes together, etc.)
- 📊 Custom GUI with improved layout
- 🎯 Skill-based bonuses (+5% per level)
- 📈 Persistent player data (NBT storage)

### Smelting System
- Earn Smithing XP and money by taking smelted items from furnaces
- Rewards for: Iron, Gold, Copper, Netherite, Glass, Bricks, and more
- Higher Smithing level = more rewards!

### Installation
1. Install Fabric Loader 0.18.4+
2. Install Fabric API 0.141.1+
3. Drop this JAR into your mods folder
4. Launch Minecraft 1.21.11

### Requirements
- Minecraft: 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader: 0.18.4+
- Fabric API: 0.141.1+
- Java: 21+

Press **H** in-game to open the Hub!
